summary: Added an SVG edge overlay across #dag that draws dependency lines (local deps solid grey #6e7681, ghost: cross-workspace deps dashed purple #8957e5), redrawn on every tick() and window resize; nodes now carry data-key for endpoint lookup. Added a header control (two task <select>s + optional workspace text input + Add button) that POSTs {from,to,fromWorkspace?} to ${BASE}/overlay/edge then calls tick().
